label: Airwallex sandbox · test money
simulated: Every merchant charge is the sandbox's simulation endpoint (`POST /simulation/issuing/create`): no merchant charged anything. The approve or decline is Airwallex's own, on the card's status, limits and merchant categories.

The crash is a SIGKILL the child process sends itself at the point the drill chose (after the thaw was recorded; or the moment Airwallex answered the thaw, before the ledger heard of it). The restart is the runner's own card code run by the drill, not a restarted runner process.

Duplicate and late webhooks are replayed locally: built from this run's own simulation answers (whitelisted fields only) and signed with a local test secret. Airwallex sent none of them; the sandbox has no endpoint that replays an event.
No passkey signs anything in this drill, and no money other than the agents' cards' test balance moves.

cards.nickname: sourcing agent: warehouse and data software (card-drill)

passes.note: The card code as on origin/main (f667d16), with the drill beside it: no card recovery at the runner's start, the thaw written to the ledger only after Airwallex answered it, and a purchase window taken by any authorisation of its amount. **This pass's webhook replay is void:** the drill's log kept each simulation answer without its date (`transacted_at`), so the 30 replayed events under a new id were refused by the hook handler as malformed (no row, no alarm) and only the 15 repeats of an id were answered "already recorded". The log was fixed and the replay re-run in pass 3.
